title: Got a literal couple of minutes? Get on my worldwide leaderboard!
author: AutomaticTalent
selftext:
http://ctrlaltdefeat.ai

The game is done, end to end. No endless demo here. 

A game takes about 45–seconds. Complete a tier in about two minutes.

Can you earn a place on the persistent worldwide high score lists?

comments.author: Uncled1023
comments.body: it didn't let me get past team selection

replies.author: Uncled1023
replies.body: i select team, it shows my team and a number, i click continue, then it just goes back to the team selection page to do it all over again.

replies.author: AutomaticTalent
replies.body: Thank you, it's not happening here of course.  I'll track it down - that's not gonna work!

replies.author: AutomaticTalent
replies.body: Hey I really appreciate this.  I tested on another machine that never played, with firefox and the flow worked fine.  I'll investigate, haven't had this reported yet although this is a late stage feature.  Than you!

comments.author: AutomaticTalent
comments.body: Scroll down to confirm after selecting?

comments.author: AutomaticTalent
comments.body: Can anyone else confirm if they can or can't load the game from the name selection screen?  Just a yes or no would REALLY help.

comments.author: multiversecitizen
comments.body: I could load the game and played the practice mode. I like the idea but my first impression is there is too much text and emojis everywhere and nobody will read most of it. Another thing is a lack of tutorial I had to discover the controls and the mechanic myself

replies.author: AutomaticTalent
replies.body:
Thank you so much for confirming the load.  Also - the discovery is part of the game (wow look what this does).   All the control info needed is on the actual [ctrlaltdefeat.ai](http://ctrlaltdefeat.ai) page but I should probably put a link to that in the how to play box.

Thank you!

replies.author: AutomaticTalent
replies.body: Fixed the main page to add info about the powerups and a GIF showing brief game play.  Then added a link to the How To Play in the game that take the player to that page. Would love your opinion.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body: I couldn't get the game to even get past loading screen , don't know how big the games upload file is but you could add a progress bar to show the person how far the loading has gotten

replies.author: AutomaticTalent
replies.body: Excellent, I'll investigate that (not sure if it works through itch.io.).  It is over 40mb because of the announcer audio (one of the really fun parts of the game).  Give it another chance?
